title: Robust Optimal Control of Arbitrarily Switched Systems: A Path-Complete Framework
summary: This paper addresses the robust control of switched systems under arbitrary switching with performance guarantees. We propose a framework that jointly synthesizes a feedback policy and a certified upper bound on its corresponding infinite-horizon closed-loop value function. The proposed upper bound not only certifies the performance of the synthesized policy, but can also be optimized during controller synthesis.
